scope: Batch 9 extraction from the undated official Planeswalker profile pages (magic.wizards.com/en/story/<name>-planeswalker). These are short character blurbs with no publication date, so they carry no era: a relation here is what the profile states, not when it held. Profiles that name no other character, faction or plane are recorded in data/lore_research/reviewed_no_claim.json instead. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.
